interface.name: zcce_window_manager_v1
interface.description: This global interface allows clients to obtain custom window management controls for their surfaces.

request.name: get_cce_toplevel

description.summary: get a cce toplevel for a surface

request.description: Create a zcce_toplevel_v1 object for a given wl_surface.

interface.name: zcce_toplevel_v1
interface.description: An interface to control and listen to CCE-specific window management states for a client surface.

request.name: set_floating
request.description: Explicitly request the compositor to place the window in floating mode.

request.name: unset_floating
request.description: Request the compositor to return the window to normal tiling mode.

event.name: floating_state
event.description: Sent by the compositor to inform the client of its current floating status.
